brief:
Khalid Abdalla, an actor, has discussed his commitment to justice and his decision to speak publicly against Israel's military operations in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. He framed his activism as part of a broader dedication to serving justice through his platform and public voice, describing it as central to his work and identity.

Abdalla reflected on the personal experiences and sense of identity that have shaped his advocacy efforts. He emphasized the importance of using his public position to address what he characterizes as genocide in Gaza, linking his activism to deeper moral and ethical convictions about responsibility and the need to speak against injustice on a global stage.
dek: The actor discusses identity, speaking out against Israel’s genocide in Gaza and the experiences that shaped him.
title: Actor Khalid Abdalla speaks against Israel's Gaza genocide
